en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large multi‑storey neoclassical villa partly hidden among tall trees. The building has balconies and ornate railings, and stands on raised pillars with an open ground floor. There is a dirt path or driveway in the foreground. Postmark and stamp cancellation marks are visible on the upper part. Greek text appears at the top left, with French text identifying the building as Villa Abdul Hamid in Salonique.
